name: brain
description: Persistent identity for an AI assistant — a self-healing knowledge graph that survives across sessions, learns from every conversation, and surfaces the right memory at the right moment. The substrate an identity accumulates into, not a RAG store.

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.description: Used to encode and surface memories (Haiku + Sonnet). Optional — leave blank if you set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your shell or in ~/.config/brain/env. Get a key at https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.

brain_path.title: Existing brain location (optional)
brain_path.description: Absolute path to an existing brain folder (the directory containing brain.db) — e.g. one you already grew on another machine. Leave blank to start a fresh, seeded brain. You can also set BRAIN_DB_DIR in your shell or ~/.config/brain/env.
